_comment: People on the road (design-return-journey.md stage 3; user: hostile fauna isn't lore-accurate for the Brisering; people are the danger: highwaymen, a toll at a bridge, desperate locals, deserters, failed Hunters gone bad; not Bermann outcasts. Encounters can turn into fights; fighting people will carry a consequence after v1.0). Everything here is the assistant's draft: numbers, people, words. people: combatants in the monsters.json format (plus 'person': true; no habitats: they never turn up on hunts). chance: per step on the Brisering, on a road or bridge / off it; quiet_km: no one bothers you this close to Bytorsskug's walls; lure: carried worth multiplies the chance by 1 + worth / lure, at most lure_cap times. Encounters: weights, who, how many, what they want.

desperate_local.name: desperate local
desperate_local.description: Thin, wary, dressed for a colder season than this. More hungry than dangerous.

highwayman.name: highwayman
highwayman.description: A road-hardened sort with a cudgel and an eye for a full pack.

deserter.name: deserter
deserter.description: Someone's soldier once, in mismatched armour with the badges cut off.

failed_hunter.name: Hunter gone bad
failed_hunter.description: Knows the Guild's ways, and knows what Hunters carry home. Whatever ended their hunting, it wasn't the miasma.

toll.title: A toll on the road
text: Figures step out where the road narrows. One leans on a cudgel. "Toll road, Hunter. {demand} shards and you walk on."
Someone has dragged a cart across the road. The people behind it aren't traders. "Road's ours this Pulse. {demand} shards to pass."

robbery.title: Waylaid
text: They were waiting for someone coming in from the edge, and here you are. "That pack looks heavy. We'll take {want}."
"Easy, Hunter. Just {want}, and nobody gets hurt." There are more of them than you'd like.

raid.title: Raiders
text: They come at the wagons from the scrub at the roadside, shouting for the drivers to stop. The caravan master looks at you: this is what you're paid for.
A cart's been dragged across the road ahead, and people are coming out of the ditches. They want the caravan's goods.

beggars.title: Hungry people
text: A few people by the road, thin as rakes. "Anything to eat, Hunter? Anything at all?"
Someone falls in beside you, then another. They're not armed, not really. "Spare some food? Or a shard or two?"
